_doc: THE THIRD RECORD OF THE URBAN BAND'S WINDOW, for the same druid rulings of 2026-10-01 (ODQ §934.86 addendum 2). It does not edit or supersede the second record, whose three acts stand. It covers J33, the census J31 owed: five readers still counted Warden's Lodge a druid or a caster in a magic world (the chains' druid tradition, druidic cultivation in both food readers, folk magic presence, the Druid Elder's seat) and two inert lists still named it. Every source change was committed first (the last at a1841d417). A successor chair does not inherit this signature.
ownerWords: "druid is magic. sorry. faith is not magic only applies to the institutions, but not divine magic substitute services. healing such as church or parish healing is an exception becasue that can also be mundane.
